column3: “Walked after” is rendered “followed”; the Hebrew “from it” is rendered “from them.”
“Entreated the face of the LORD” is rendered “entreated the favor of the LORD.”
“As yesterday three days ago” is rendered “as formerly.”
“Asherah pole” is rendered “the Asherah,” and NASB adds “standing.”
“Wept on his face” is rendered “wept over him,” and “chariotry” as “chariots.”
“Make your hand ride on the bow” is rendered “Put your hand on the bow.”
NASB adds “for,” and “until making an end” as “until you have destroyed them.”
“Coming of a year” is rendered “in the spring of the year”; the meaning is uncertain.
“He went and touched” is rendered “when the man touched,” and “lived” as “revived.”
“From His face” is rendered “from His presence.”
“Returned and took” is rendered “took again,” and “struck him down” as “defeated him.”
